{{Quote|Oh, man. Maybe I did use a little too much Boontaspice.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="SOTE" />}}
'''Boontaspice''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] used in cooking. It was a key ingredient in the foul-smelling [[Giju stew]], although not even Boontaspice could mask the dish's odor. The restaurant [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served [[Boontaspiced mustard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before its closure early during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once tried to make [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] [[Stew/Legends|stew]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] but found to his revulsion that he had used too much Boontaspice.

==Description==
Boontaspice was a type of cooking [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="SOTE" /> It was edible to both [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]]<ref name="Besalisk" /> and [[Human/Legends|Humans]], but too much of it could cause an adverse taste reaction in the latter [[Species/Legends|species]]. Boontaspice shared its name<ref name="SOTE" /> with [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE-Boonta">{{CSWECite|I|85|Boonta}}</ref> located near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard [&hellip;] it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu description for the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
Boontaspice was the namesake additive of [[Boontaspiced mustard]], a meal component served at the restaurant [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the restaurant's proprietor, used Boontaspiced [[Mustard/Legends|mustard]] in two dishes on his menu, the [[Giju slider]] and the [[gartro egg salad sandwich]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

[[Giju stew]] was a dish best made with a bit of Boontaspice, but even it could not mask the [[Stew/Legends|stew's]] foul odor.<ref name="CSWE" /> In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] [[3 ABY/Legends|following]] the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once tried to prepare [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] stew for himself and his friends [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] while aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. To his great distaste, Calrissian used too much Boontaspice in his recipe and decided to scrap the stew and eat something else.<ref name="SOTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boontaspice first appeared in the [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']], written by [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="SOTE" /> Its name references Boonta, a planet originating in the 1980s animated television series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']].<ref name="Droids">{{SW|url=news/from-boonta-to-baobab-droids-and-the-star-wars-prequels|text=From Boonta to Baobab: ''Droids'' and the ''Star Wars'' Prequels|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu, later created Boontaspiced mustard as a variation of Boontaspice.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
